title: The const-Probe Concept
prompt: Implement `Sized` as an ad-hoc `requires requires` clause probing `c.size()` **on a const reference** (with a `std::convertible_to<std::size_t>` result), and `totalIfSized(c)` returning the size — or -1 through the fallback for unsatisfying types.

tests.name: sized containers report their size
tests.hint: template <class C> concept Sized = requires(const C& c) { { c.size() } -> std::convertible_to<std::size_t>; };

tests.name: unsized types hit the fallback
tests.hint: The unconstrained fallback overload (declarable as a template taking any C) returns static_cast<std::size_t>(-1).

tests.name: a non-const size() does NOT satisfy
tests.hint: The probe must be requires(const C& c) — a non-const size() fails the probe, so the fallback answers.
